description.0: A sword made from sacred wood, said to have once turned the tide of battle.

0.0: When the equipping character hits the opponent with an attack within 12s after using the Elemental Skill, they gain the "Verdant" effect, which increases their ATK by <cryo>4%</cryo> and their Elemental Mastery by <cryo>20</cryo>. This effect lasts 6s and can trigger once every second. Max 3 stacks. The aforementioned effects can still trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field.
0.1: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The effect of "Verdant" is changed to: Increases ATK by <cryo>6%</cryo> as well as Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by the equipping character by <cryo>8%</cryo>.
